root_idea.summary: The root centers on inclination toward what is desired and beneficial: good as opposed to evil, excellence, preference, and choice.
root_idea.development: The underlying sense of turning or inclining develops into goodness and benefit, comparative superiority, the excellent or chosen, generosity, and seeking the better of two alternatives.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form V perfect citation form.
Displayed under the normalized Form VIII perfect citation form.
Displayed under the core nominal/adjectival headword خير.
Displayed under the supported singular feminine citation form خَيْرَةٌ, while retaining the supplied feminine-plural Quranic group.
Displayed under the normalized noun citation form خِيَرَةٌ.

senses.definition: To select or choose what is regarded as good or preferable.
senses.usage_conditions: Form V; the Quranic occurrences are imperfect forms meaning “they select” and “you choose.”

senses.definition: To choose, select, elect, or prefer someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: The object may be selected from among others or preferred over them. In the account of the chosen community, the usage can also be understood as God making them good or preferring them over others.

senses.definition: Goodness, good, benefit, or a good thing; what is desirable, useful, or excellent, as opposed to evil or harm.
senses.usage_conditions: Used both as a noun and as an adjective. Depending on context, it may denote good deeds, beneficial outcomes, welfare, or good things generally.
A Quranic usage in which خير denotes accumulated wealth or property, especially in contexts of inheritance, spending, ownership, or provision.

senses.definition: Better, best, or excellent; the superior or most excellent among alternatives.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in comparative and superlative constructions, including comparison with مِنْ, genitive superlative expressions, and plural forms referring to the excellent or best.

This is an explicitly reported Quranic interpretation of خير. The lexical interpretation is retained, but Lane’s printed Quran reference is historical and is not converted into a modern verse citation.

senses.definition: Good things, good deeds, or acts of goodness.
senses.usage_conditions: Feminine plural of the adjectival or substantivized sense of خَيْرَةٌ; the Quranic contexts use it for good things and virtuous deeds.
Feminine plural used as an epithet for women characterized as good or excellent, especially in disposition and qualities.

senses.definition: Choice or option; the right to choose.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, it may deny people an independent choice against God’s determination or choice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become possessed of good or goodness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I intransitive usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be good or do good; in supplication, to grant someone good or choose the better outcome for them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes idiomatic prayers asking God to bless, prosper, favour, or choose the better alternative for someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prefer one person to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive usage with a person or thing preferred before a companion or rival.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone the choice or option between two things or affairs; to prefer one among others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II; may describe granting an option or preferring some people or things over others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To vie or contend with someone for superiority or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III; competition may concern a particular matter or quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: How good or excellent!
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV exclamatory construction, including expressions praising the suitability or goodness of something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend together for superior goodness or excellence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI reciprocal usage; the cited construction includes appealing to a judge or arbiter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or ask for divine blessing, favour, or the better outcome.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X; commonly takes God as the object of asking and an affair as the matter in which the better alternative is sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A kind of small, sweet-smelling grain resembling cardamom.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plant name, reported as a Persian-derived expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Generosity, liberality, or munificence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun denoting generous character or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Eminence, nobility, or an elevated state or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct abstract noun sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Origin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical noun sense distinct from generosity and appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nature or disposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person’s inherent or characteristic disposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Form, aspect, appearance, figure, mien, or external condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Equivalent in this usage to a person’s visible form or aspect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The blessing, prospering, or favour granted by God; the favourable state resulting from seeking God’s choice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun or substantive associated with asking God to choose or provide the better outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chosen or selected thing, person, or beast; one’s choice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Substantive associated with choosing or being chosen; this classical “chosen item” sense is distinct from the Quranic abstract sense of choice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to good or goodness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Relational adjective formed from the خير lexical family.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of, relating to, or possessing generosity, liberality, or munificence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Relational adjective associated with the خِيرٌ sense of generosity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The gilliflower or wallflower plant, generally the yellow species.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical term reported as Arabicized; its oil was used in medicines.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert plant identified with the خُزَامَى.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Compound botanical name referring to a strongly scented wild plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quality of goodness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Abstract noun denoting the quality associated with خَيْرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A contractual option, especially the option to accept or return a purchased item.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes options based on inspection, a sitting with the seller, a defect, a stipulated condition, or later specification of the selected item.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cucumber or cucumber-like plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An Arabicized botanical word, explicitly reported as not originally Arabic.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cassia fistula tree or its well-known fruiting tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A compound plant name, itself Arabicized from Persian.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Doing good or acting well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of خَارَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Voluntary or originating from the will or choice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical adjective opposed to خِلْقِيٌّ, something innate or created as an inherent quality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of good; excellence, eminence, or nobility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Abstract noun for a quality or circumstance producing excellence or elevated status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Choosing, selecting, or electing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle of Form VIII اِخْتَارَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Chosen, selected, elected, or preferred; choice or select.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Passive-participial or substantivized usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excellent or choice, especially of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival usage applied to a male or female camel, including the sense of excellent and brisk.

cautions: The core nominal group combines noun and adjective uses and includes the Quranic plural surface form أَخْيَارِ under the normalized headword خَيْرٌ.

Lane’s horse interpretation of خير is preserved as Quran-attested lexical evidence, but its printed reference uses an older citation convention and does not supply a secure modern location matching the QAC occurrence.
